rachel: quick heads-up: while updating the v2 migration guide I found a streaming framing quirk that should be documented before the deprecation banner goes live.

rachel: v1 apps often relied on the `json_stream` framing produced by the shim; in v2 we recommend using content schema + structured output. some SDKs still emit the old framing which makes downstream parsers break.

tom: can you paste a repro?

rachel: small repro in PR comment: call the v2 chat endpoint with legacy param `stream: true, format: 'json_stream'` and you sometimes get mixed frames (old json fragments + new event tokens).

li: ok that's bad. we should add a migration note: 1) stop using format: 'json_stream', 2) use content_schema + on-token callbacks, 3) include a tiny smoke test to assert that the first non-empty chunk parses as a valid JSON object or starts with "data: [DONE]" for legacy.

rachel: I'll add the checklist and the smoke test (node + curl) to docs PR #4788. include a short parser snippet showing robust handling.

tom: also add a section explaining SDK behavior: v1 SDK accepts `format: 'json_stream'` and silently maps it; v2 SDK will soon error on that param. document current behavior and recommended replacement.

docs-ci-bot: PR 4788 opened by rachel 1 lint/build queued.

li: timeline: try to land migration note + scripts today. we should also flag product/comms for the banner copy to mention "streaming framing changes".

rachel: added tests + examples in the PR, assigning @tom for review. will ping here when link is ready.

tom: reviewing now. tiny wording nits but 👍 for capturing the user surprise.

rachel: merged after nits. follow-up: add SDK changelog entry and a small code sample showing on-token vs structured parsing.

li: great, thanks. this will save a lot of flakey parsing bugs on customer side. :raised_hands:
